title: Sinus floor elevation using a sintered, natural bone mineral - A histological case report study.*# Rothamel, D, Smeets, R, Happe, A, Fienitz, T, Mazor, Z, Schwarz, F
authors: Zöller, J. Zeitschrift für zahnärztliche Implantologie 2011; 27(1): 60-70.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss cerabone (sintered bovine bone) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “It was concluded that BEGO OSS acts as an osteoconductive material to support hard tissue regeneration after sinus floor elevation. Showing excellent volume stability, it is integrated into newly formed bone mat rix within a six-month healing period. *Study refers to BEGO OSS, which was a private label of cerabone®. # Publication in English and German. 06/2023” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
